name: Royal Guard
uniques: [-10]% Strength for enemy [Military] units in adjacent [Mountain] tiles

civilopediaText.text: Brave foreigners and fearsome soldiers who have left their families to answer the King's call. Kyrat has adopted them as her own because she knows that her best interest is in their hearts. May Pagan's light shine upon them all.

name: Chosen
uniques: May Paradrop to [Land] tiles up to [5] tiles away <in [{Friendly} {Land}] tiles>
Never appears as a Barbarian unit

civilopediaText.text: The Chosen are the Cult’s best soldiers and experienced in tactics with military gear. They are often found planning future operations or performing maintenance on their planes.

name: Mercenary
uniques: Never appears as a Barbarian unit

civilopediaText.text: These men answer to an ex-military commander, Oliver Tambossa. The man is a fucking chameleon. You won’t see his true colors until it’s too late!
